svg.text: One sponsor is 72%–89% of a video's income; finance outgrows the need at 24k views.

In the amber zone, take the sponsor. Right of it, turn one down when it hurts the video.
In the amber zone, take the sponsor. Right of it, turn one down when it hurts the video.
Sponsor rates per view run 3–8x the niche's RPM, so one integration outweighs the ad income in every niche. That is why the
sponsor zone is wide in low-RPM niches: gaming and entertainment depend on sponsors across most channel sizes. Q1 cuts ads by
about 15%, which moves every right-hand edge 18% further right, so a channel near its green edge needs a sponsor in Q1 even if
it doesn't the rest of the year.
RPM, sponsor rate per 1,000 views and edit cost: maintainer_estimate rows in data/2026/benchmarks.csv. Creator marks: creator_report
rows (cpv_brand) in data/<year>/creators.csv, each linked to the creator's own rate card.
